}}'''Kyril Shianri''' is a nobleman and counselor to king [[Paitar Nachiman]] of [[Arafel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kyril Shianri}}

== Appearance ==
He is tall, lean and elegant. He wears silver bells on his boot tops, gloves, and braids. He usually has an expression of dissatisfaction.

== Activities ==
He is goes with King [[Paitar Nachiman]] to the meeting of the Borderland rulers.
